name: Yam-Izhora-Gatchina Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: the only sourced figure (41.78 km) is the re-laid scope in a contractor (Proektneftegaz) project list entry 'MG Yam-Izhora-Gatchina. Pereulozhka gazoprovoda 41,78 km', not a stated full line length; OSM trace is ~31.5 km DN720. No diameter, capacity, commissioning year or operator-side document found, so no value can be put in a [ref] cell without an orphan/uncertain value. Not rejected as a duplicate: not a section of P1456 (803 km Serpukhov-Kalinin-Leningrad) or P2285 (765 km Belousovo-Leningrad), both of which end at the St Petersburg/Yam-Izhora-Kolpino node; the Yam-Izhora system is listed separately by the same contractor (MG 'Yam-Izhora-Shosseynaya' loop, MG 'Yam-Izhora-Kolpinskoe PKhG', and MG 'Kipen-Gatchina' as a distinct line). Re-check if an operator or Leningrad Oblast territorial-planning document gives the length and diameter.
researcher_notes: Existence: real operating Gazprom Transgaz Sankt-Peterburg trunk (named in contractor project list; Yam-Izhora is a node near Kolpino, Tosnensky district; a sibling entry shows 'Yam-Izhora-Shosseynaya' as a separate loop). Single contractor source, tier low. Match-to-existing check of the 285-row Russia gas roster found no Yam-Izhora/Gatchina row; nearest are P1456, P2285, P5534/P5535 (Gryazovets-Leningrad), P2326/P5589 (Kohtla-Jarve-Leningrad), all long trunks into St Petersburg with different endpoints; a short DN720 Yam-Izhora to Gatchina branch is not an obvious section of any. Candidate would clear threshold legs (a) sponsor and (b) endpoints, and (c)/window as an operating line never captured, but fails (d): length not sourced as a full-line figure. Route: not researched (monitor).
